capabilities: Connect a GitHub repository, branch, and subfolder to a vault folder and download files
Sync changes via manual or automatic batched commits and merge non-overlapping text edits
Resolve overlapping, binary, and deletion conflicts without inserting markers into notes
Keep connected notes and attachments available offline
Save standalone full-vault snapshots with resolved links and generated backlinks
disambiguation: Not a Git client; it never clones the repository, creates branches, or runs Git commands.
extras: Not yet accepted into the Obsidian community directory; installed manually from GitHub Releases. Full data inventory in PRIVACY.md and third-party notices in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to edit and synchronize a GitHub repository folder without installing Git or using a paid sync service.

relations.evidence: Connect an existing GitHub repository, branch, and subfolder to a new or existing vault folder.

summary: GitHub-backed sync that connects repository subfolders to vault folders, merges edits without installing Git, and saves standalone vault snapshots.
